newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey says killed 30 rebel Kurds in southeast.
newsitem.headline: Turkey says killed 30 rebel Kurds in southeast.

text.p: Turkish forces have killed 30 Kurdish rebels in clashes in the southeast in the last two days, security officials said on Wednesday.

A statement by the emergency governor's office in Diyarbakir said 21 rebels of the Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) were killed in the southeastern Sirnak province, eight in neighbouring Siirt and one in Bitlis.
Turkish troops, backed by tanks and heavy artillery, pushed across the border into northern Iraq earlier on Wednesday in an apparent move against separatist PKK rebels based there, witnesses said.
More than 22,000 people have been killed in more than 12 years of fighting between the army and the PKK, which is seeking autonomy or independence in mainly Kurdish southeastern Turkey.
